about:
Fabrika Outdoor Living operates a warehouse in Honolulu, Hawaii, where it stocks a range of outdoor living models for customer purchase by appointment. The company’s headquarters and distribution center are located in Honolulu, serving the local market with a showroom-style experience. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The business carries a variety of models at its Honolulu warehouse, with stocked items typically delivered within two to five business days after purchase. Umbrella orders generally require ten to fourteen days for delivery. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Fabrika Outdoor Living serves residential and commercial customers in Hawaii seeking outdoor furniture and shade solutions, though specific industry verticals or named clients are not publicly listed. The company’s website provides a point of contact for appointments and product inquiries.

No public statements detail the company’s founding mission or competitive differentiators beyond its warehouse-based fulfillment and appointment model.
